svg.title: Study 3 design: federation against GraphQL Adapters and Guided Direct Access on effort, with accuracy as a floor
svg.desc: The design of Abstraction ladder study 3 (run study3-scored-1), drawn from its design page. Federation, Apollo Federation and Cosmo Federation weighted equally, is compared with GraphQL Adapters (P1) and with Guided Direct Access (P2), which reads study 2's guide unchanged; Direct Access is a reference block outside the confirmatory families. Tool calls are the primary family and cost a second family, each with Holm over P1 and P2; the CSL family is two one-sided tests on P1 tool calls, forward against reverse on 54 tasks and join width on 91 tasks; accuracy is a floor of 10 percentage points that gates every claim; time and the legacy load are descriptive. The scored set is 113 tasks: 107 core, study 2's 76 pool tasks and 31 new, and 6 ambiguity tasks reported apart; by the fields direction and csl 30 reverse, 24 forward, 4 link integrity (direction none) and 55 other none. The runs follow study 2's Williams square and halves, 904 runs in the four full arms, plus a Direct Access block of 226, 1,130 runs. No results are shown.
